# Ledger and locator entries for the fictional northern districts

Narrative entry: In 1841 Factor Iven directed removals on the Rannoch Estate in
Glen Mora. The entry names the estate and factor; it does not attribute the act
to every member of the House of Rannoch.

Narrative entry: The House of Brannoch crossed the North Ford in 1694 and later
settled near Loch Vey. Captain Sera Brannoch supported the Northwatch companies
in 1718. These statements establish chronology but do not connect Brannoch to
the Rannoch removals.

Index entry: Northwatch Regiment -- Dunbrae, Blue Watch, An Freiceadan Gorm,
1712, 1718, 1720. This is locator evidence; the chronicle provides the narrative
support.

Graph-shaped lead: House of Brannoch and House of Rannoch are both mentioned in
the northern-district collection. Their collection adjacency is not evidence of
an alliance, conflict, kinship, or participation in the same event.
